atoms.exact_source_text: Good Home play produces successful stillness.
atoms.normalized_claim: The design destination for Home states good play produces successful stillness.

atoms.exact_source_text: A named member of the colony who contributes one equal Home share, occupies a current Role, may travel Away, and carries individual history.
atoms.normalized_claim: Citizen is defined as a named colony member contributing one equal Home share, occupying a current Role, able to travel Away, and carrying individual history.

atoms.exact_source_text: A variable-output worker token or permanent profession.
atoms.normalized_claim: Citizen is not a variable-output worker token or permanent profession.

atoms.exact_source_text: A share of current civic responsibility: Builder, Caretaker, Watchkeeper, and so forth.
atoms.normalized_claim: Role is defined as a share of current civic responsibility such as Builder, Caretaker, or Watchkeeper.

atoms.exact_source_text: A character class, aptitude score, or lifelong career.
atoms.normalized_claim: Role is not a character class, aptitude score, or lifelong career.

atoms.exact_source_text: The repeated communal activity sustained by a Role: upkeep, cultivation, warning, teaching, care, fabrication.
atoms.normalized_claim: Practice is defined as the repeated communal activity sustained by a Role, such as upkeep, cultivation, warning, teaching, care, or fabrication.

atoms.exact_source_text: A hidden production recipe detached from daily life.
atoms.normalized_claim: Practice is not a hidden production recipe detached from daily life.

atoms.exact_source_text: The built or claimed environment in which a Practice becomes materially possible and socially legible.
atoms.normalized_claim: Place is defined as the built or claimed environment in which a Practice becomes materially possible and socially legible.

atoms.exact_source_text: A stand-alone factory whose primary purpose is output per minute.
atoms.normalized_claim: Place is not a stand-alone factory whose primary purpose is output per minute.

atoms.exact_source_text: A deliberate, time-bounded undertaking measured in Citizen-Days: construction, expansion, repair, preparation, or memorial work.
atoms.normalized_claim: Project is defined as a deliberate, time-bounded undertaking measured in Citizen-Days, such as construction, expansion, repair, preparation, or memorial work.

atoms.exact_source_text: An endless passive queue that must remain full.
atoms.normalized_claim: Project is not an endless passive queue that must remain full.

atoms.exact_source_text: A global colony state such as Structural Condition, Stores, Cohesion, or seasonal preparedness.
atoms.normalized_claim: Condition is defined as a global colony state such as Structural Condition, Stores, Cohesion, or seasonal preparedness.

atoms.exact_source_text: A separate health bar on every wall, ladder, pantry, and burrow.
atoms.normalized_claim: Condition is not a separate health bar on every wall, ladder, pantry, and burrow.

atoms.exact_source_text: **Named Citizen** | **occupies** | **Role** | **sustains** | **Practice** | **inhabits** | **Place**
atoms.normalized_claim: A Named Citizen occupies a Role, which sustains a Practice, which inhabits a Place.

atoms.exact_source_text: Role assignment is fluid and colony-scaled.
atoms.normalized_claim: Role assignment is fluid and colony-scaled.

atoms.exact_source_text: Reassigning a Citizen changes the colony's posture; it is not a respec operation.
atoms.normalized_claim: Reassigning a Citizen changes the colony's posture and is not a respec operation.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Citizen assigned as a Builder contributes one Builder Capacity regardless of personality, Away statistics, or prior assignment.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Citizen assigned as Builder contributes one Builder Capacity regardless of personality, Away statistics, or prior assignment.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player sees exactly which Citizens make up the total, preserving individual apportionment without turning Home into a personnel-ranking puzzle.
atoms.normalized_claim: The player sees exactly which Citizens make up the total, preserving individual apportionment without turning Home into a personnel-ranking puzzle.

atoms.exact_source_text: Home gives Citizens history. Away gives Citizens progression.
atoms.normalized_claim: Home gives Citizens history while Away gives Citizens progression, forming the identity boundary.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Role normally sustains an ongoing Practice.
atoms.normalized_claim: A Role normally sustains an ongoing Practice.

atoms.exact_source_text: Positive margin may be redirected into a Project.
atoms.normalized_claim: Positive margin from a Role may be redirected into a Project.

atoms.exact_source_text: Builder Capacity first covers the colony's routine Building Load; any remaining margin can accelerate a construction Project or prepare for forecast pressure.
atoms.normalized_claim: Example: Builder Capacity first covers the routine Building Load, and remaining margin can accelerate a construction Project or prepare for forecast pressure.

atoms.exact_source_text: The system does not describe ordinary life as Citizens being "idle" when no queue is active.
atoms.normalized_claim: The system does not describe ordinary life as Citizens being idle when no queue is active.

atoms.exact_source_text: Species identity is embedded directly into land use.
atoms.normalized_claim: Species identity is embedded directly into land use.

atoms.exact_source_text: A well-designed settlement should remain identifiable when uninhabited.
atoms.normalized_claim: A well-designed settlement should remain identifiable when uninhabited.

atoms.exact_source_text: Placement alignment is represented primarily by how layout changes relevant Load, route resilience, warning, care, and failure propagation - not by a generic universal percentage pasted onto every system.
atoms.normalized_claim: Placement alignment is represented primarily by how layout changes relevant Load, route resilience, warning, care, and failure propagation, not by a generic universal percentage applied to every system.
